title: core: canonicalize name-keyed Call-edge callers in flow (fix BFS truncation)
description: Follow-up to CORE-1, surfaced by PROD-1: the pipeline keys Call-edge caller by the enclosing *name* while callee is a symbol id, silently truncating trace()/waves() at the name/id boundary on real indexes. Fix at the source in crates/core/src/flow.rs: build the adjacency with callers canonicalized to symbol ids (unique symbol with that name whose range contains the call line -> id; ids round-trip; ambiguous or file-level callers stay raw - honest partial resolution beats a wrong path), and resolve user-facing endpoints (A/B/wave source) the same way (exact id -> unique name -> raw-in-edges -> honest miss). Existing edge-only tests must stay green unchanged; add tests for name-keyed multi-hop trace, waves from a name source, and ambiguous-caller honesty. The CLI's local workaround in commands/flow.rs::normalized stays (idempotent). Owner: crates/core/src/flow.rs only. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core.
